column8: ["Every seat has a dark upper-left crescent and a bright lower-right highlight; replace this directional shading with symmetric tones under diffuse light.","The pale, bulging seat interiors read as installed beads or deep cups rather than empty, open seats; flatten and clear their centres.","The connecting channels are narrow, dark double rails that lose readability against the tile seams; broaden them into clear, continuous brass paths."]
